summary.headline: Astrological and Lunar Miscellany
summary.text: Catalog entries for folios 255–271v, covering magical prognostications, lunar doctrine, thunder omens, a life-timing theme by Eleutherius Zebelenus, astronomical and astrological miscellany, Aleim’s judgments, the nature and parts of the horoscope, and lunar activities. Authorities include John Laurentius Lydus, Eleutherius Zebelenus, Aleim son of Isaac, Apomasar, Moses’ son, and Ptolemy.
